newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas selling.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas selling.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended down on Thursday from New York's previous close on selling from producers and Europe, dealers said.
Bullion ended at US$321.20/70 per ounce on Thursday against New York's previous close at US$322.75/25 on Wednesday.
"The morning producer selling from Australia lent a bearish tinge to the market and everybody followed suit locally," said one source.
Gold dropped from around $322.60 per ounce to the day's low of $320.50/321.00 per ounce as Europe jumped into the fray in early afternoon.
This sparked a brief shortcovering rally and some physical demand which lent support to prices, dealers said, pushing gold back above $321.00 per ounce.
Dealers saw good support at $320 and $319 per ounce
Local tael gold ended HK$29 down at HK$2,974.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society dropped to -6.00 from its previous fix at +1.00.
